name: Cannabis
description: Cannabis — the flagship crop of the growroom system. Photoperiod varieties shift from 18 h vegetative light to 12 h bloom light; week-by-week nutrient schedules map to the canna-coco and sensi-coco fertilizer families. Check local legality before cultivation.

careNotes.note: Maintain high humidity and gentle light until roots or cotyledons establish.
Water at first sign of light substrate dry-back; avoid saturated media.
Defoliate and lollipop in mid-veg to improve light penetration.
Low-stress training (LST) or SCROG increases canopy uniformity.
